parameters.name: FuzzyGroupName
parameters.description: The name used for fuzzy match of groups.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID.

You must specify the instance ID. Otherwise, the call fails. You can view your instance ID on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.
><notice>
If no ID is available for the public instance, refer to [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).
></notice>

parameters.name: PageId
parameters.description: The current page number, starting from 1. Maximum value: 10000.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: ProjectCode
parameters.description: The project ID, which is the unique identifier of the project. You can obtain the project ID from the [Project Management console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/things-service/projects).
